AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'PM-in-Server: add real Part3+4 GTM-cert completion tracking to pm-sentinel-tick.sh (min tokens, real audit, real cert)' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  PROGRESS.md                                        |   2 +-
 gtm_part34_certification_check.py                  | 220 ++++++++++++++
 pm-sentinel-tick.sh                                | 109 +++++++
 ...4156-pm-in-server--add-real-part3-4-gtm-cert.md |  94 ++++++
 test_pm_sentinel_tick.py                           | 326 +++++++++++++++++++++
 5 files changed, 750 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
Evidence Recorded: The new code itself is well-engineered (correct, verified use of superboss-register.py's private _connect()/_write_lock()/record_ocid_master_standard_audit_event()/_lookup_ocid_governing_umr() internals matching their real signatures, parameterized SQL, fail-closed exit codes, OR-semantics content search matching the established _fts_query() convention, no touches to the frozen dispatch_core.py or to .github/workflows/**), but this PR duplicates a feature that was already implemented and merged to origin/main hours before this PR's own commit was made: commit 37d6f89 ('feat(pm-sentinel-tick): add real Part3+4 GTM-certification completion check (Check 4)', 2026-08-15 14:50:29 UTC) already added an OCID-020 GTM certification Part3+4 completion-tracking Check 4 to pm-sentinel-tick.sh on origin/main, using a different design (a `superboss-register.py list-gtm-categories` CLI subcommand plus a `list_gtm_certification_categories()` function whose own docstring explicitly names itself as 'the one real reuse point pm-sentinel-tick.sh's Check 4 ... queries live every tick'), a different governing UMR citation (UMR-20260815-044235-a5e1), and a different ocid_master_standard_audit_log event_type string (gtm_part3_4_completion_certificate). This PR's commit (ef46b55, 2026-08-15 23:06:07 UTC) independently re-implements the identical feature from an older base, via a new standalone gtm_part34_certification_check.py script with its own different event_type string (gtm_part3_4_certification_complete) and its own different governing-UMR citation, apparently without pulling/checking origin/main's current state first. Merging this now would either fail to apply cleanly against the already-changed Check 4 block in pm-sentinel-tick.sh, or (if force-merged) install two parallel, inconsistent Check 4 implementations that could both dispatch independently for the same gap and write two different event_type values to the audit log for what is conceptually one certification event -- a direct NO DUPLICATION/NO COLLISION violation per the standing dispatch instructions, not a code-quality defect in the diff itself. Issues found: Duplicate/superseded work: origin/main already has this exact feature merged (commit 37d6f89, 2026-08-15 14:50:29 UTC, 'feat(pm-sentinel-tick): add real Part3+4 GTM-certification completion check (Check 4)'), predating this PR's own commit ef46b55 (23:06:07 UTC) by ~8 hours -- this PR was built from a stale base and did not detect the collision before dispatch/completion, violating the NO DUPLICATION/NO COLLISION rule.; The two implementations use different ocid_master_standard_audit_log event_type strings for the same real-world event (this PR: gtm_part3_4_certification_complete; already-merged main: gtm_part3_4_completion_certificate) and different governing-UMR citations -- if both ever land, downstream consumers keying off event_type would get inconsistent/incomplete results.; This PR does not reuse superboss-register.py's already-merged list_gtm_certification_categories(), whose own docstring states it exists specifically as the designated reuse point for this Check 4 -- instead it duplicates the same query logic in a new standalone script, compounding the collision rather than reconciling with it.; Recommended resolution: close/reject this PR, verify the already-merged Check 4 on origin/main (commit 37d6f89) is functioning correctly against the live gap state, and if any genuine gap remains (e.g. this PR's dedup-search-for-untracked-seed-dispatches idea), file it as a small targeted follow-up against the current main implementation rather than a parallel reimplementation.
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.

This is additive-only (new files, new tests, one new shell block, one doc/progress file) with no schema/auth/payment/migration paths touched, matching tier1 classification; safe to merge autonomously.
